adjudication.rationale: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(...) } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which swallows the thrown error and logs no `err` details (stack/message) and uses `console.log` instead of a structured logger. This doesn’t break core functionality (guests are still added and calendar attendees updated), but it makes production email failures hard to debug and is directly grounded in the added code.
